objective: Create the safe PC cleanup audit package. This is design and inventory tooling only: no deletion, no local execution, no paid services. Define a structured audit schema, a discovery procedure, a read-only PowerShell inventory script that can later be run manually on Windows, and an Astra review packet. Update project memory/provenance. The audit script must never delete, uninstall, modify registry, stop services, or alter files.

acceptance_criteria: Output collision handling uses an atomic create-new primitive, not a separate existence check followed by Set-Content.
An existing output file cannot be overwritten even under a race; collision produces a clear error.
A new output file succeeds and default stdout creates no file.
worker_result_*.json anywhere under ActiveProjectRoot is KEEP_ACTIVE.
All six Astra Review #1 corrections remain satisfied.
Review packet remains pending and does not fabricate CI evidence.

Fix before applying the candidate to PR #1.

Broaden worker-result protection so worker_result_*.json is KEEP_ACTIVE anywhere inside ActiveProjectRoot, not only at repository root. Use a boundary/path-aware regex on the normalized relative path.

Keep Astra Review #1 fixes already implemented: .github/.gitignore protection, candidate-root array shape, absolute-path deduplication, root validation, enumeration failures surfaced, PowerShell 7 prerequisite, exact provenance semantics, zero spend, audit-only behavior.
